newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy sees June state sector surplus grow.
newsitem.headline: Italy sees June state sector surplus grow.

text.p: Italy saw a state sector surplus of some 29.5 trillion lire in June, about 4.5 trillion lire up on the same month last year, the Treasury Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.
It added that Italy's public sector borrowing requirement in the first six months of the year was roughly 25.4 trillion lire against 53.746 trillion in the same period in 1996.

Italy has pledged to cut its deficit in 1997 to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP), as demanded by the Maastricht Treaty for countries wishing to sign up to the single European currency, from 6.7 percent in 1996.
Treasury Minister Caro Azeglio Ciampi said last week that state accounts in July were also expected to show an improvement on 1996 levels. -- Rome newsroom +396 678 2501
